full_name: Rey Chow | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Rey Chow is the Andrew W. Mellon Professor of the Humanities at Brown University, where she teaches in the Department of Comparative Literature and in the Department of Modern Culture and Media.
